sentences.text: This {stage} {sex} bearded seal was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}.
Bearded seals live in Arctic and sub-Arctic waters with sea ice and feed mostly on the sea floor.
He never strayed far: his farthest position, on {farthest_date}, was {max_displacement_km} from where tracking began.
His record includes a long silence of {longest_gap_days} with no positions.
Why the tag went quiet isn't recorded. The map shows the gap as a dashed line, not a guessed route.
